title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability
author: Miguel Torres
commits: 8f9a3b: add observability hooks for unified rollouts (metrics/traces)
b4c2d1: emit canary/ab/shadow traffic tags and rollout-id in traces
d3e4f5: add e2e test for metric-driven autorollback trigger
f7a1b0: fix flaky shadow-path tracing & guard nulls
description: Context: This PR adds observability and telemetry improvements for Unified Rollouts (canary, A/B, and shadow traffic paths) and wires those signals into the automated rollback workflow. Motivation: Rollouts are doing more automatic decisions (metric-driven rollbacks, quarantines) but we lacked consistent tracing tags, per-rollout metrics, and end-to-end tests to ensure observability-driven decisions are debuggable in production. What this PR does: - Emit rollout_id, rollout_stage (canary/ab/shadow), variant, and sampling_reason tags on request traces and logs. - Add per-rollout Prometheus metrics: rollout_requests_total, rollout_error_rate, rollout_latency_seconds_bucket, rollout_quarantine_count. Metrics include labels for model, region, and policy_version. - Expose a rollout-level aggregated view in the tracing pipeline so rollback decisions can be correlated to traces. - Hook the autorollback engine to surface diagnostic metrics that can be annotated on rollback events for post-mortem. - Add an e2e test that simulates a canary with elevated error rate to validate the rollback trigger and metric emission. Checklist: - [x] Add tracing tags in runtime request path - [x] Add Prometheus metrics and register on startup - [x] Add rollout event annotation to autorollback events - [x] Add e2e test and integration alerts smoke test - [x] Update docs (internal observability runbook) Testing: unit tests added for metric label generation; integration pipeline validated locally and in CI; e2e test added to perf-canary job and ran against staging. Impact: Backwards compatible. No changes to API surface. Requires that monitoring stack (Prometheus/tracing) picks up new labels; dashboards will need minor updates (included in release notes).

review_comments: Emily Zhang: Overall looks good. Please ensure the new metrics use existing label cardinality patterns (avoid region+model explosion). Can you add a unit test for label normalization?
Miguel Torres (author): Added label normalization test and limited model label cardinality by using model_family where appropriate (see commit 8f9a3b).
Priya Nair: The e2e test is great; I saw a flake on the first run when shadow traffic didn't annotate correctly. Did you guard for nil rollout metadata?
Miguel Torres (author): Fixed nil guards in tracing_tags.go and added an explicit check in the e2e harness (commit f7a1b0).
Tomás Rivera: Can we expose a short-lived rollout debug endpoint for on-call to fetch recent rollout metrics & traces? If so, add to ops docs rather than in this PR.
Miguel Torres (author): Agreed. Added a follow-up ticket ENG-2589 and included a note in the runbook.
ci_checks: e2e (perf-canary): initially failed (flaky trace guard) -> re-run passed
release_notes:
- Observability: Add rollout-level metrics (rollout_requests_total, rollout_error_rate, rollout_latency_seconds_bucket) and tracing tags (rollout_id, rollout_stage, variant).
- Autorollback: rollback events now include metric annotations for easier debugging.
- Testing: added e2e test for canary autorollback.
Notes: Dashboards must be updated to use model_family label to avoid high cardinality. Backwards compatible; no API changes.
